arguments.title: Tracking Anything with Decoupled Video Segmentation
key_claims: Image segmentation and temporal propagation can be decoupled, allowing current image masks to be reused. The paper uses bidirectional consensus and notes delayed discovery of new objects between image-model updates. This motivates an independent mask-stability arm, not detector replacement. It also means future-aware propagation cannot be silently used in a supposedly causal visual forecast. For the first test, bounded Cutie propagation from fixed anchors is simpler; DEVA remains a supported alternative under a distinct recipe, with fresh-object and persistent-false-positive controls.
